crew.overview: Aspiring Florida defense lawyer Kevin Lomax accepts a job at a New York law firm. With the stakes getting higher every case, Kevin quickly learns that his boss has something far more evil planned.
crew.title: The Devil's Advocate

details.biography: Andrew Neiderman is a best-selling American novelist, arguably best known as the author of "The Devil's Advocate". In 1987, he became the ghost writer for V. C. Andrews following her death in 1986.
details.name: Andrew Neiderman
details.place_of_birth: New York City, New York, USA
